angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 848,065 km at 55.95 pc = 0.2 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.8725 +/- 0.0206 mas (same row, RUWE 1.22): 55.95 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.219 (1.195 to 1.243) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 848,065 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.142 (1.102 to 1.182) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6162 +/- 0.9 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6489603813690967808: teff_gspphot 6162.0986 K (16th-84th percentiles 6161.1514-6162.958), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6489603813690967808: teff_gspphot 6162.0986 K (16th-84th percentiles 6161.1514-6162.958), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
